title: Adding pathfinding to our AI NPC's
author: NoAutoPilotYT

comments.author: NoAutoPilotYT
comments.body: Prior to this update, our AI NPCs would find themselves stuck in bushes or fences. Good progress!

replies.author: arinawilson
replies.body: AI is undoubtedly a revolutionary component for AI game development. Great progress BTW.

comments.author: Alankordas
comments.body: What is the goal for the NPCs movement ultimately? To walk around based on a daily schedule?

replies.author: afriday11
replies.body: Our biggest technical goal with this system is to move beyond just talking NPC and give them the ability to plan and act in the sandbox world.
